study: US100 CPI/NFP/FOMC mirrored reversion full research pipeline
date_override: User explicitly requested development in 2020 through 2024 inclusive, rest OOS. Global last-two-year policy remains unchanged; this study uses 2020-2023 search and 2024 finalist validation, then 2025+ evaluation only.
holdout_label: Chronologically held out from this parameter search, but retrospective: the recent one-year results were inspected and used to choose US100 and the bidirectional strategy before this study. Not untouched OOS.
calendar_scope: Scheduled CPI, NFP and scheduled FOMC policy-decision releases; no speeches, minutes or separate press-conference entries. Unscheduled 2020 Fed interventions excluded because their timestamps were not scheduled trading triggers.
expectation_filter: None: a complete historical market-consensus archive has not been retrieved; not a verified priced-in-news model.
selection: One-factor stages with beam width two, then stop/impulse/hold neighbourhood plateau check. At most three development-only finalists evaluated on 2024. Stability selection, not maximum return; no OOS reselection.
execution_quality_caveat: Native archive has many zero-spread 2026 entry quotes. Measured extra-spread sensitivity and delay reruns are mandatory diagnostics, but cannot establish accurate historical fills without reliable event-level bid/ask history.
